business_problem: Seekr needed a scalable way to evaluate huge volumes of digital and podcast content for brand safety and suitability without relying on manual, subjective, and expensive review, while also finding enough cost-effective compute capacity for growing LLM training, inference, and deployment workloads.
solution_summary: Seekr runs SeekrAlign and its LLM development stack on Intel Tiber AI Cloud to replace costlier self-managed infrastructure and scale trustworthy content analysis. Audio from podcasts and other digital content enters Seekr’s inference pipeline, where Intel Data Center GPU Max Series 1550 systems using Intel Extensions for PyTorch perform transcription and diarization. A 7B model on an 8-node Intel Gaudi 2 AI accelerator cluster then categorizes sensitive content and performs risk assessment. SeekrFlow orchestrates the end-to-end LLM pipeline through an API, versioned executables, custom components, and alignment algorithms. Separate 4th gen Intel Xeon Scalable processor clusters handle application monitoring, storage management, and vector and inverted-index database services that support Seekr’s RAG services and pipeline operations. Results are surfaced in the SeekrAlign dashboard as real-time podcast suitability scores.
